name: Ronda
description: Ronda is a Moroccan fishing game played with a 40-card Spanish pack. Players capture cards by playing matching ranks or ascending sequences. Ronda (pair) and Tringa (three of a kind) announced at deal score 1 and 5 pts. Este/caida (matching last played) scores 1-11. Target 41.

overview.description: Ronda is a Moroccan fishing game played with a 40-card Spanish pack. Players capture cards by playing matching ranks or ascending sequences. Ronda (pair) and Tringa (three of a kind) announced at deal score 1 and 5 pts. Este/caida (matching last played) scores 1-11. Target 41.

history.origins: Popular in Morocco: Rabat, Marrakesh, Fez, Tangier. French, Spanish, Arabic terms.

setup.deck: 40 Spanish (clubs, cups, swords, coins; 1-7, 10-12). 10 adjacent to 7.
setup.dealing: 3 each; 4 face up on table. No pairs or 4-card sequence in layout. Deal 3 more when hands empty. Anticlockwise.

rules.objective: Capture cards; score ronda/tringa, caida, mesa. First to 41 wins.
rules.gameplay: 1. Before play: announce Ronda (pair) = 1 pt or Tringa (triplet) = 5 pts. Best wins all. 2. Play one card. If matches table card: capture pair + all higher in ascending sequence. If no match: trail. 3. Este/caida: capture last played = 1 pt. Third same rank = 5; fourth = 10. 4. Mesa: clear table = 1 pt.

strategy.basic: Announce ronda early. Delay false ronda to block opponent win.
strategy.intermediate: Track played cards; challenge false announcements.
tips: False ronda: legal tactic to delay scoring.

variations.name: Card transfer
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant describes alternative scoring method; no engine overrides needed for build.

scoring.description: Ronda, tringa, caida, mesa, card majority.
